title: RELAY_HOME means two different folders
what: One variable names one folder: install.sh uses RELAY_HOME for the folder with relay's code, while lib/relay_config.py uses RELAY_HOME for the state folder (~/.relay; the code folder is RELAY_ROOT there). install.sh uses RELAY_ROOT for the code folder, like the rest of relay.
why: Found 26 Oct while answering the owner's install question: install.sh:21 `home="${RELAY_HOME:-$HOME/relay}"` (the code), lib/relay_config.py "HOME_DIR: ~/.relay (RELAY_HOME overrides)" (the state). Setting RELAY_HOME for one breaks the other.
failing_case: RELAY_HOME=/tmp/x sh install.sh --dry-run looks for deps.toml in /tmp/x, while relay itself would put its ledger there.
pass_cases: install.sh reads RELAY_ROOT for the code folder; RELAY_HOME means only the state folder everywhere (git grep RELAY_HOME shows one meaning).
where: install.sh:21 RELAY_HOME as relay's code folder
lib/relay_config.py RELAY_HOME as the state folder ~/.relay
